title: A worker re-runs the stale-doc check after rebasing, rewords a gate that gate add made blocking, and edits only under its own worktree path
goal: the fixed worker rules tell a worker to run git fetch and git rebase origin/main and then selfdoc.py stale --since origin/main again before it names its Self-Reviewed docs (land rebases first and stops at the stale step for a doc the worker's earlier run did not list), to reword a gate whose gate add output says made blocking so it stays provisional unless its choice guards a rule, and never to edit a path under the orchestrator's checkout

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_dispatch
rules = " ".join(r if isinstance(r, str) else " ".join(x for x in r[1:] if x) for r in bl_dispatch.WORKER_RULES).lower()
miss = [w for w, p in (("rebase", "rebase"), ("blocking gate reworded", "made blocking"), ("own worktree paths", "orchestrator's checkout")) if p not in rules]
assert not miss, ("the worker rules do not cover", miss)
